profile.summary: TNTP is a national nonprofit, formerly called The New Teacher Project, that works with schools, districts and states on education. It provides education consulting, research and policy work, and leadership and talent development. It was founded in 1997.

review.notes: This is the same New York, NY nonprofit that appears in the agenda as 'The New Teacher Project'. ProPublica lists 'Tntp Inc / The New Teacher Project Inc' as a 501(c)(3) in New York, NY with EIN 13-3850158, and TNTP's About page says the organization was founded in 1997 and renamed TNTP in 2011. TNTP's Contact and About pages support every profile field (TNTP, Inc., 500 7th Avenue, 8th Floor, New York, NY 10018, 718-233-2800, and its consulting, research/policy and leadership/talent services).
